messages: lina: Build on staging blew up after the mkdocs theme swap. linkcheck shows multiple broken anchors (old short ids vs new slugified ids). Example: /how-to/deploy#gpu-tiling -> /how-to/deploy#how-to-deploy-gpu-tiling docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck failed (exit 1). 9 broken anchors. Logs: . :boom: sam: The theme normalizes ids to include parent path parts, so lots of internal and external links break. We can't realistically edit all external references. harper: Agreed. Two safe approaches: 1) update every source link (ugh) 2) restore legacy anchors into generated HTML during the build (post-process). lina: Post-process sounds lower risk. Can we auto-generate the mapping from mkdocs nav and headings so it's maintainable? sam: Yes. I can output a csv map during mkdocs build: old_id,new_id,page.html by scanning headings and storing their original short ids before the theme rewrites them. harper: Then a tiny injection step can insert anchors like "" next to the new id. Needs to be idempotent (don't duplicate) and fast. vic: I sketched a bash+perl one-liner earlier but better to do a small Python script so we can unit test. Requirements: read anchors_map.csv, for each entry insert legacy anchor before element with the new id if legacy not present. Skip files > 3MB to be safe. lina: Also add a grep in CI to catch any lingering references in docs/ so we don't silently rely on the shim forever. We'll still want a follow-up to update changelog pages and any important external docs links. sam: I'll open a PR: branch docs/anchor-shim-180123. Files: scripts/inject_legacy_anchors.py, scripts/generate_anchor_map.py, tests/test_inject.sh, and CI change to run generator -> build -> injector -> linkcheck against injected site. harper: Make the injector skip when the exact legacy id string already exists in the file. And include a dry-run mode that prints counts so we can preview. vic: Add a small fixture page in tests/fixtures/ that includes an existing manual anchor to ensure injector doesn't clobber it. Also add a unit test to ensure duplicate anchors are not produced. lina: We should add a short note to docs/migration/theme-change.md describing the break and the shim behavior and how authors can opt out (add `legacy_anchor: false` in frontmatter?). sam: Good idea. I'll make the generator respect a frontmatter flag `legacy_anchor: false` to opt-out for pages intentionally renamed. Default is true to preserve compatibility. docs-bot: PR opened by sam: 44d linkcheck job queued. harper: Quick risk note in the PR: small chance of mismatched ids if people manually crafted anchors that coincide with generated old ids. Tests mitigate this. Rollback is just removing the post-build step. vic: After merge, I'll run a canary preview and full linkcheck across translations. Coordinate with infra for a preview build slot. lina: Thanks. Assign harper + vic as reviewers. Also tag release for changelog update once this lands. harper: :thumbsup: One more ask — add a short script `scripts/find_old_anchor_refs.sh` that greps for `#gpu-tiling` style references so we can triage high-traffic link targets to fix upstream later. sam: Will include it. Opening PR now. lina: Great. After merge, let's monitor external link errors for the next week and follow up with permanent fixes where feasible. docs-bot: CI: PR merged. build-stage preview scheduled. vic: Preview looks clean. Linkcheck passed on the injected site. I'll run the localized linkchecks next. lina: Awesome, thanks everyone — nice low-risk workaround.
